title: Best AI to create visual novel sprites?
author: Nevermind2031
selftext:
I'm making a visual novel and I need placeholder character visuals at least until I have money to hire someone to actually draw the sprites, if I never get that money then I will just keep the Ai ones.

Either way I'm looking for a free AI that can generate a character without background and consistent with different emotions (At least 8-9 per character).

I'm not the best with art tools and stuff, it's probably easy to generate one normally and then crop the background but i think it's easier to just make it straight away.

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body:
Chatgpt can. You just need to prompt it correctly .make a ref sheet first of the character. Ai loves to use ai for itself.

That you want like 2 rows. Say each expression. Make sure you also put that you want the full body to be in the expression. Shoulders etc. this was made 2 version back now it can do transparency so it would save time as well.  This is example of a character I did for one I did.
